items.title: Free Play Days – NBA 2K27, Crusader Kings III, The Alters, Bus Simulator 21, Soccer Story and Ravenswatch
items.summary: Happy Free Play Days! Game Pass members can jump into NBA 2K27, Crusader Kings III, Bus Simulator 21, Soccer Story and Ravenswatch this weekend, while all XBOX players can enjoy a timed trial for The Alters.
items.content:
Whether you’re chasing Championships or forging a legacy, there’s a new adventure waiting for this Free Plays Days. Crusader Kings III , Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop , Soccer Story , and Ravenswatch are available this weekend for XBOX Game Pass Ultimate, Premium and Essential members to play from Thursday , October 15 until Sunday , October 18 .

NBA 2K27 Standard Edition is also available beginning Frida y, October 16 at 12pm PDT until Sunday , October 18 .

Watch out! The Alters will have a free 3-hour timed trial from Thursday , October 15 until Sunday , October 18 . All players can try it out, no Game Pass membership required.

Scroll down and find and install the games on each of the individual game details page on XBOX.com. Clicking through will send you to the Microsoft Store, where you must be signed in to see the option to install with your XBOX Game Pass Ultimate, Premium and Essential membership. To download on console, click on the Subscriptions tab in the XBOX Store and navigate down to the Free Play Days collection on your XBOX One and XBOX Series X|S.

Purchase the game and other editions at a limited time discount and continue playing while keeping your Gamerscore and achievements earned during the event! Please note that discounts, percentages, and title availability may vary by title and region.

NBA 2K27 Standard Edition Hit the court and hoop with friends this weekend as NBA 2K27 joins Xbox Free Play Days.

Starting October 16, you can create a MyPLAYER and lace up in The City, build a legacy in MyCAREER, and compete with NBA and WNBA superstars in Play Now. Take advantage of Xbox Free Play Days from October 16 to October 18 and get ready for NBA Tip-Off. Also, from October 16 to October 29, purchase any digital edition of NBA 2K27 and get an Xbox Gift Card plus a 15,000 Virtual Currency Pack.

Crusader Kings III Love, fight, scheme, and claim greatness. Determine your noble house’s legacy in the sprawling grand strategy of Crusader Kings III . Death is only the beginning as you guide your dynasty’s bloodline in the rich and larger-than-life simulation of the Middle Ages. Play Crusader Kings III for free now on XBOX Series X|S!

Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop Hop aboard Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop during Xbox Free Play Days, October 15–18! Drive officially licensed buses, explore two open-world cities, and build your bus company solo or with friends in online co-op.

Soccer Story Try Soccer Story for free as part of Xbox Free Play Days, and if you want to play even more, you can grab the game for 85% OFF! The world might as well be over – Soccer Inc. has closed down every local stadium, team and tournament. What kind of world can survive without the beautiful game? Thankfully a magical soccer ball has chosen you, our Savior of Soccer!

Ravenswatch Recall the fairy tales of old and join the Ravenswatch ! In this roguelike action game, battle nightmares, power up your abilities, and collect items to craft a build that takes you to the endgame.

Playable solo or in up to 4-player co-op, Ravenswatch recently celebrated its second anniversary. A new hero, Kintaro, inspired by Japanese folklore, has joined the fray, fighting alongside his bear companion. The DLC arrives alongside a talent rework for all heroes, changing the way they play. And for those who don’t want the fun to end, Ravenswatch will be 65% off during the free play weekend.

The Alters Stranded on a hostile planet, you create alternate versions of yourself to survive. But each Alter is shaped by a branching life path, and they don’t always agree on your choices – current and past ones. The Alters is a personal survival game that fuses mechanical depth with emotional storytelling, asking one haunting question: What if you had made different choices? Build your base, manage resources, care for your Alters mental wellbeing, and reckon with regret in this award-winning experience.

Don’t miss out on these exciting Free Play Days for XBOX Game Pass Ultimate, Premium and Essential members! Learn more about Free Play Days here and stay tuned to XBOX Wire to find out about future Free Play Days and all the latest XBOX gaming news.

items.title: Ravenswatch Adds New Kintaro Character DLC
items.summary: Ravenswatch has added a brand-new DLC character to the mix, as you can get the chaotic axe-wielding Kintaro riding a giant bear.
items.content:
Posted in: Games , NACON , Video Games | Tagged: Ravenswatch

Ravenswatch has added a brand-new DLC character to the mix, as you can get the chaotic axe-wielding Kintaro riding a giant bear.

Nacon and Passtech Games have released a new paid DLC for Ravenswatch , this time adding the character Kintaro. The shorthand to this particular addition is to give you someone who is into chaotic combat, as you're literally getting an axe-wielding warrior riding a giant bear. We have mroe info about them below as they are available for $8 starting today, if you believe they're worth the cash to add.

Hailing from Japanese folklore, Kintaro is a powerful hero armed with a gigantic axe. He can fight while riding his bear, Kuma, or let his faithful companion wreak havoc alongside him on the battlefield. As such, he has two sets of abilities, offering greater complexity as well as flexibility depending on the situation. Riding Kuma, players can slice through Nightmares with his claws. On foot, they can swing Kintaro's axe and unleash devastating combo attacks with his carnivorous sidekick.

In addition to the DLC, Passtech Games is rolling out a major update eagerly awaited by many players: a rework of Talents, the heroes' special abilities. The studio has been very attentive to the community, observing gameplay patterns and taking player feedback into account to rework these Talents. Some have been rebalanced, others merged, and still others have simply been added or removed. As a result, all heroes now have new ways to play through their active and passive abilities, with the goal of revitalizing the gameplay experience.

Ravenswatch is a top-down roguelike action game in which you play as heroes of tales and legends that must slay hordes of nightmarish creatures in nerve-racking fights. After the success of Curse of the Dead Gods, Passtech Games returns with an improved formula and an addictive game experience with endless replay value. It can be played solo or with up to four players in co-op.

Ravenswatch’s latest addition brings a gigantic axe and a very angry bear.

The Kintaro DLC is available now for £6.59 on Xbox (with versions of other formats too), introducing a new playable hero whose partnership with Kuma offers a fresh twist on the game’s fast-paced roguelike combat.

Inspired by Japanese folklore, Kintaro arrives in Reverie as a brave, supernaturally strong hero determined to push back the Nightmare. Raised in the mountains by the ogress Yama-Uba, he remains untouched by the corruption affecting the other heroes.

His most interesting feature, however, is the way he fights. Kintaro can switch between riding Kuma and battling on foot alongside his companion, effectively giving players two combat styles to master.

Mounted on Kuma, Kintaro can tear through enemies with powerful claw attacks, charge across the battlefield and use a mighty battle cry to block incoming attacks. Fight on foot, meanwhile, and Kintaro swings his enormous axe while Kuma automatically attacks nearby foes. You can also direct the bear’s movements, adding a tactical element to positioning both fighters.

They share a health bar, but damage dealt to Kuma becomes Internal Damage for Kintaro. Switching back onto his companion gradually restores those wounds, making positioning an important part of surviving the Nightmare.

The DLC includes Kintaro’s own abilities, Talents and two Ultimates, alongside seven exclusive outfits and seven narrated Memories following his journey across Reverie.

There’s more happening across Ravenswatch, too. A major update reworks hero Talents, with abilities rebalanced, combined, added or removed. The changes aim to give all heroes new ways to approach combat, offering returning players fresh opportunities to experiment with their builds.

We awarded Ravenswatch 4.5/5 in our review , praising its engaging combat, varied characters and rewarding progression. As we noted, the game has the potential to convert players into roguelike enthusiasts.

Kintaro looks like a fitting addition to that roster. With two fighting styles to juggle and Kuma doing plenty of the heavy lifting, the latest hero offers a compelling reason to return to Reverie – preferably with a good grip on that axe.

Pick up the DLC right now from the usual stores. We’ll point you to the Xbox Store .

items.title: Ravenswatch gets 13th hero Kintaro in paid DLC + free update also overhauls 50+ talents
items.summary: A new legend called Kintaro has joined the Ravenswatch, and the base game just got a massive talent overhaul, too.
items.content:
It has been two years since Ravenswatch first launched, and in that time the game has grown via several DLC drops to include a dozen playable characters – and you can make that 13 after a new one landed today: Kintaro.

If you’re not already in the loop, the game has a focus on hero characters drawn from different mythologies and fairy tales. The co-op systems built around these legends have helped Passtech’s action-roguelite stand out from the crowd of similar Hades-likes – here’s my Ravenswatch review if you’d like to find out more.

The newest addition to Ravenswatch lands today in a paid-for DLC pack, which is available on PC, PS4/5, Xbox Series, and Nintendo Switch.

On top of that, there’s also a free update available to all players, which offers a major reworking of the game’s talents (more than 50 have been “tweaked, buffed, or replaced”).

As you can see in the infographic below, Custom Lobbies have also been added, alongside the usual raft of QoL updates.

As for the main event, you’ll have to pay £6.99 or the regional equivalent to get access to Kintarō, who comes to the game with a big axe and a rather useful bear companion called Kuma.

This duality means both complexity and flexibility. “Riding Kuma, players can slice through Nightmares with his claws,” the Steam page explains. “On foot, they can swing Kintaro’s axe and unleash devastating combo attacks with his carnivorous sidekick.”

If you’d like to see the new addition to Ravenswatch doing their thing, there’s a new promo trailer below, embedded for your convenience.

Still with me? Of course you are! If you want to keep reading about great hand-picked roguelikes, this website is absolutely chock-full of them. Head over to the Guides Page for a concentrated hit of roguish games, organised via sub-genre and platform.

What’s more, there are always going to be new lists for emerging trends as well as fresh titles to highlight. This is because my backlog is embarrassingly long, and so I’m always trying to balance the new games that arrive in my inbox with playing the stuff I already have.

Finally, if you would like to keep track of our original reporting and support the work that we do here in this most niche corner of the Interweb, please make sure we’re one of your trusted sources on Google News . Alternatively, there’s an RSS feed , if you prefer.

You can also join our communities on Reddit and Bluesky , where I/we post all of our content and where you can share your thoughts and recommendations. We also have a burgeoning presence on YouTube . Come and say hello; we try to keep all of these spaces welcoming!

items.content:
Greetings, Ravens!

The release date for Kintarō's Hero DLC and our new free update is fast approaching! Now is the time to reveal more details about this new content. Watch out for spoilers!

The Kintarō's Hero DLC will be released on October 12 on all platforms.

Kintarō joins the Ravenswatch! (Hero DLC)

Kintarō is a famous figure in Japanese folklore, symbolizing bravery and innocence.

In Ravenswatch, Kintarō was raised by Yama-uba, an ogress of the mountain, and lives in harmony with the wild. He speaks to animals, wrestles bears, and carries the mountain’s strength.

DLC Content

The idea behind Kintarō was simple: switch between a classic playstyle and dual gameplay, controlling two characters at once. Kintarō is a child mounted on a bear who wields an axe with exceptional strength!

Kintarō and Kuma are coming to the Ravenswatch with a full arsenal of Abilities and Ultimates that let them create devastating builds and synergies!

Check out Kintarō in action in his introduction video, which breaks down his entire ability set and play style:

Discover Kintarō's story in his fully voiced storyline. The Golden Boy's mother, Yama Uba, sent him on a quest to deliver a message to the witch Baba Yaga. Along the way, Kintarō will discover the lands of Reverie, which have been overrun by destructive creatures, and meet the heroes of the Ravenswatch.

Here is an excerpt from Kintarō's Memoirs:

My Yama-uba

wrinkles spread across your face

Ike rivers in spring

My Yama-uba, old ogress of the wild. I speak to you in my thoughts because here no one hears me.

You raised me like the old mountain Ashigara shelters the forest. You watched me from above among the birds and trees, where the wilderness was free and untamed like me! The animals were my brothers and sisters.

\[...]

You entrusted us with a message enclosed in a flower and sent us away.

So I bear Ashigara’s hope, I remember your face and long for my return.

(Yes, we added a bunch of haikus!)

Unlock exclusive Outfits for Kintarō and his bear, Kuma! Customize your look on the battlefield with 7 skins available in this DLC:

Kintarō's Animations

Animating Kintarō and his bear was a real challenge for our animation team! With two very different characters, one a child and the other a four-legged animal, we had to get extra creative to deliver fluid, impressive, and dynamic animations.

In this episode of Raven Eye, our 3D animators Étienne and Benoît take you behind the scenes of Kintarō’s animation. Watch the video closely, you’ll even get a little sneak peek at one of Kintarō’s Ultimates in action!

Wishlist Kintarō's DLC!

Playing as Kintarō means knowing when to switch between two types of highly dynamic, all-out combat. There’s nothing more satisfying than climbing on and off the Bear in the middle of a fight to string together devastating attacks!

Whether you prefer to join forces or fight alongside your faithful companion, Kintarō introduces a whole new way to approach combat.

Kintarō's Hero DLC will be available across all platforms for $7,99

Free Update

Along with the DLC, a free update will also be available to all players! This update will focus primarily on reworking existing Hero talents. But that's not all!

Talents Rework

In this video, Slymane (Game Designer at Passtech Games), whom you're starting to know, reveals the philosophy behind the Talents Rework players have been eagerly awaiting and gives you a sneak peek at what’s new.

With buffs, behavior changes, and Talents removed and replaced, you’re sure to find a breath of fresh air in this free update! We've revised more than fifty Talents. We'll detail everything in the patch notes upon release, along with design notes from Ravenswatch's designers.

Custom Lobbies

As part of our ongoing effort to improve the Ravenswatch multiplayer experience, we’ve focused this update on creating custom lobbies. Many of you have asked us for this feature, which now lets you choose the number of players you'd like to find in a matchmaking game.

We’ve also added an option to enable a ping indicator between players, so you can check if your connection with your teammates is stable.

General Balancing & QoL

As usual, we've made a general balancing pass and added some quality-of-life features to the game. Let's have a look at the most significant ones.

Melodies Balancing

In our latest update, “Songs of Thieves,” we introduced the Melodies mechanic. So it was only natural that we looked at your feedback and made some adjustments.

Among the most common pieces of feedback, some players didn’t like that the Fairy Godmother Melody wasn't available until Chapter 3, or that the Little Tailor Melody didn't trigger until Level 10. Here are the changes we’ve made to these two melodies:

Melody

New Effect

Fairy Godmother Melody: Will now be available on every Chapter

Little Tailor Melody: Will now trigger above level 6, but grant 1 power-up instead of 3

Scarlet Transformation

Scarlet transforming into a wolf, and back again, while the Master Nightmare is stunned? That’s over! We know how frustrating it was to lose those precious seconds of combat. From now on, Scarlet will wait until the boss regains consciousness before shapeshifting!

Clarity of Hero Status Effects

It used to be hard to tell when our character was in “Invincible” or ‘Intangible’ mode, or when they were “Blocking” attacks. Now, a small text appears above your Hero, making their status effects much clearer!

Dev Q&A

If you missed it, we can watch back our live Q&A from this week during Kintaro's live Showcase on Twitch and YouTube. We answered a ton of community questions, starting at 1:19:08.

Well, well! We had a lot to say! It won't be long now until the release of the Kintaro DLC and its accompanying free update.

We'll see you in Reverie!

Songs of Thieves Statistics

It’s been almost a month since the Thieves arrived in Reverie. Did they cause the trouble we were hoping for? Let's take a look at some stats together!

(Updated statistics compared to the presentation video)

The Thieves have been deadly, with a total of 264,273 heroes killed since they began their ambush! The stats show that Elite Assassins are the main culprits behind this massacre, with over 171,928 heroes slain!
